limits: Main 2 contents x 9 builds x 4 skill sets x 2 policies x 8 seeds = 1152 runs; new seeds 8-15 cover 3 builds x 2 skills x 2 policies x 2 contents = 192 runs. Total 1344.
All matrix profiles have exactly 2 points; no-skill retains 2. Unlocks are controlled availability fixtures, not claimed natural rewards.
C24 changes only passage V0 HP32 to24. Enemy, support, rewards, skills, card effects and schedules remain AH values.
Card-count proposals and comparisons are authored before outcomes. They are not user-built decks or exhaustive optimisation.
Natural sequences: each entrance seed s, C seed (s+1)%8, one retry after C death at seed (s+2)%8. No reroll to seek success. No C attempt if entrance did not clear.

Fork keep-initial and use-earned-reward from the same return. Use earned points only, PS02 first then free reallocation to PS04 on death; same policy. These are alternatives, not duplicate receipts collected by one profile.
Runtime policies use AH public choices. They do not optimise placement for stored-card bonuses or infer plans from retained knowledge.
No formal adoption, UI deployment, automatic enemy scaling, new slots, material use or old-result replacement.
